title: Check Then Act
statement: Implement `solve(ops)`. `ops` is a list of keys. A cache get-or-set stores a key the first time and returns `hit` when it is already present. Return the list of `miss` or `hit` in order. Under a lock this is one decision per key. Do not record two misses for the same key.
hints: Use a set of seen keys.
A new key appends miss and is added.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Check-then-act without a lock lets two threads both see a miss and both store.

editorial: Check-then-act without a lock lets two threads both see a miss and both store. The lock makes the check and the insert one critical section. The sequence of miss and hit is what a single-threaded locked run produces, which is the race-free result.
